payload.error_semantics: transport and provider errors are explicit
payload.license_semantics: pinned license evidence controls permitted use
payload.no_data_semantics: no data is distinct from transport or schema failure
payload.pagination_semantics: cursor token is explicit and stable
payload.rate_limit_semantics: provider policy defines a fixed request window
payload.retry_semantics: only bounded retryable errors may be retried
payload.revision_semantics: stable source identity and monotonic revision are required
payload.source_publication_semantics: source publication time is preserved when available
payload.total_semantics: reported total is authoritative for coverage
payload.valid_zero_row_semantics: zero rows require successful terminal coverage evidence
